verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capability in the evidence is on the Logs page, which can filter requests and export the filtered list as CSV or JSON in one action. That is a read-only export, not true bulk operations on many items. missing for 10: a batch or bulk request API for submitting many model calls at once, bulk management actions (keys, budgets, projects), programmatic bulk operations via API or CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
